description: This file defines the ProxyBackend class which implements server-side logic for managing MCP providers, client connections, and tool invocation within the Playwright framework. It includes methods for initializing clients, listing tools, switching connection methods, and handling server closure.

classes.name: ProxyBackend
classes.description: Implements server backend for managing MCP providers, client connections, and tool invocation in Playwright.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend with client information.

methods.name: listTools
methods.description: Returns a list of available tools, including a context switch tool if multiple MCP providers are configured.

methods.name: callTool
methods.description: Invokes a specified tool with given arguments, handling context switching if needed.

methods.name: serverClosed
methods.description: Handles server shutdown by closing the current client connection.

methods.name: _callContextSwitchTool
methods.description: Handles switching the connection method to a different MCP provider.

methods.name: _defineContextSwitchTool
methods.description: Defines the tool used for switching browser connection methods.

methods.name: _ensureCurrentClient
methods.description: Ensures there is an active client connection, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: _setCurrentClient
methods.description: Sets up a new client connection using a specified MCP provider.
